title: Wednesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Playing a weaker team
hook: Your team is clearly better today. Now what?
intro: Two innings in, the outcome is clear.
statement: An easy game can still be a good lesson.
q1: Do you give your team new challenges to work on —
q2: or let everyone enjoy an easy win?
q3: What skill could they practice in this game?
t1: Every game is different. But both teams benefit
t2: when the stronger team plays with purpose.
cta: Coaches — what do you do in a mismatch?
ctaLines: Bunt only. New positions. Opposite-field hitting.
A new challenge or enjoy it?
ctaPrompt: Share your game habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Your team is clearly better today. Now what?
Two innings in, the outcome is clear. Your players are getting bored.
An easy game can still be a good lesson.
A new challenge or an easy win. Every team is different.
What do you do in a mismatch? Share your habit in the comments.
